an3.67:1.3: Atītaṃ vā bhikkhave addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya --
an3.67:1.5: anāgataṃ vā bhikkhave addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya --
an3.67:1.7: etarahi vā bhikkhave paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya --
an3.67:2.1: Kathā-sampayogena bhikkhave puggalo veditabbo yadi vā kaccho yadi vā akaccho ti.
an3.67:2.2: Sacāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ekaṃsa-vyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ekaṃsena vyākaroti, vibhajja-vyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na vibhajjavyākaroti, paṭipucchā-vyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na paṭipucchā-vyākaroti, ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ṭhapeti, evaṃ santāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo akaccho hoti.
an3.67:2.3: Sace panāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ekaṃsa-vyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ ekaṃsena vyākaroti, vibhajjavyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ vibhajjavyākaroti, paṭipucchā-vyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ paṭipucchā-vyākaroti, ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ ṭhapeti, evaṃ santāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo kaccho hoti. 3.
an3.67:3.1: Kathā-sampayogena bhikkhave puggalo veditabbo yadi vā kaccho yadi vā akaccho ti.
an3.67:3.2: Sacāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ṭhānāṭṭhāne na saṇṭhāti parikappe na saṇṭhāti aññavāde na saṇṭhāti paṭipadāya na saṇṭhāti, evaṃ santāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo akaccho hoti.
an3.67:3.3: Sace panāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ṭhānāṭṭhāne saṇṭhāti parikappe saṇṭhāti aññavāde saṇṭhāti paṭipadāya saṇṭhāti, evaṃ santāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo kaccho hoti. 4.
an3.67:4.1: Kathāsampayogena bhikkhave puggalo veditabbo yadi vā kaccho yadi vā akaccho ti.
an3.67:4.2: Sacāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno aññenāññaṃ paṭicarati bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti, evaṃ santāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo akaccho hoti.
an3.67:4.3: Sace panāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno nāññenāññaṃ paṭicarati na bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti na kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti, evam santāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo kaccho hoti. 5.
an3.67:5.1: Kathāsampayogena bhikkhave puggalo veditabbo yadi vā kaccho yadi vā akaccho ti.
an3.67:5.2: Sacāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno abhiharati abhimaddati anupajagghati khalitaṃ gaṇhāti, evaṃ santāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo akaccho hoti.
an3.67:5.3: Sace panāyaṃ bhikkhave pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno na abhiharati na abhimaddati na anupajagghati na khalitaṃ gaṇhāti, evaṃ santāyaṃ bhikkhave puggalo kaccho hoti. 6.
an3.67:6.1: Kathāsampayogena bhikkhave puggalo veditabbo yadi vā sa-upaniso yadi vā anupaniso ti.
an3.67:6.2: Anohitasoto bhikkhave anupaniso hoti ahitasoto sa-upaniso hoti.
an3.67:6.3: So sa-upaniso samāno abhijānāti ekaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti ekaṃ dhammaṃ pajahati ekaṃ dhammaṃ sacchikaroti ekaṃ dhammaṃ.
an3.67:6.4: So abhijānanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ parijānanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ pajahanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ sacchikaronto ekaṃ dhammaṃ sammāvimuttiṃ phusati.
an3.67:6.8: etadatthaṃ sotāvadhānaṃ yadidaṃ anupādā cittassa vimokho ti. 7.
